## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `make test` passes (`make test-db` if the store changed)
- [ ] `make notices` run and the result committed, if a Go module or console dependency changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` line added, if users will notice the change
- [ ] `docs/data-handling.md` updated, if the agent collects, or the server stores or sends, something new
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
